versions.changelog:
Initial release of the web-design-guidelines skill.

- Provides a consolidated static UI code audit (accessibility, forms, animation, images, performance, UX copy) and Lighthouse (95+) verification workflow.
- Reports evidence-based findings (file:line or Lighthouse JSON) and groups confirmed issues into Draft SPECs.
- Operates strictly as an auditor and planner—never edits source code; all fixes flow through a SPEC/issue pipeline.
- All user interactions are in Portuguese (pt-BR), while artifacts are in English.
- Implements strict guardrails: audits only production URLs (never localhost), provides evidence for each finding, and segregates roles between audit, planning, and execution.
- Not for designing or fixing UIs directly; only for audits and planning based on real interface and runtime evidence.
